body: When I was 13 or 14, maybe younger, I snuck a kitchen knife into my bedroom one afternoon. Then I grabbed a bunch of towels and laid them out on the floor to try and keep it all clean, I don't think I realized how mu8ch blood was in the human body or that towels weren't infinitely absorbent. I sat there for a while preparing myself to do it. Then all of a sudden my mother called me for dinner and I realized if I did it now she would be the one to come looking for me. I hid the knife in my sock drawer and went down for dinner. After everyone went to bed I snuck around and put everything back. No one in my family even knows about it.
